text: Nu Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NU) filed its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

source.quote: Nu Holdings Ltd. ("Nu" or the "Company") (NYSE: NU) hereby informs its shareholders and the market that it has filed today, April 8, its Annual Report on Form 20-F
